pkgmetadata.longdescription: kaarten-update downloads Garmin .img maps (a .zip with a .img inside, or a plain .img) from HTTP(S) servers when the server has a new version (ETag/Last-Modified), and installs them into a QMapShack map directory and onto every connected Garmin device in USB drive mode (recognised by Garmin/GarminDevice.xml). Which maps is configured in ~/.config/kaarten-update.toml; messages are in Dutch.
